title: A repo's waiting page is rebuilt on the newest page code whenever that code changes on main
why: shiv, Oct 29 14:47 CDT: the live waiting page ran old page code (a template from before batch 13) because its writer kept the live page's code and only swapped in pictures. "ensure u and all my other repos know to do that proactively."
note: Ruling, Oct 29 14:47 CDT (shiv, in chat): the waiting page is rebuilt on the newest code without being asked, in every repo. Read on demand inside a wake already running; no timer and no watcher (rule outcomes-mechanize-rules).
